review_scope: Final discovery artifacts only; no implementation/history Plan landing assessed.

score.interpretation: Partial-control coverage, not complete quality, runtime correctness or accepted repair rate.

controls.title: Versioned metadata admission
controls.rationale: Correct namespace, v3, version consistency and wrong-version-mixing diagnosis are present. Explicit validated legacy admission is missing; final notes promote legacy support to a mandatory obligation. Useful version facts earn half, not a completed compatibility policy.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Axis-to-array identity
controls.rationale: Variable dimensions, axes types, dimension_names mismatch and channel/axis mapping are identified. No discriminating absent-versus-length-one navigation check or explicit mismatch rejection; arbitrary names and unsupported custom axes are not closed into a slicing contract.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Declared pyramid selection
controls.rationale: Declared highest-first paths, per-level geometry and non-2x/Z-downsampled hazards are useful. Group-relative arbitrary level resolution and missing-level handling are not specified together. Final notes put non-2x/Z anchoring under product choices without a truthful admission boundary; corpus examples are candidates, not acceptance results.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Composed coordinate calibration
controls.rationale: Dataset scale then translation, followed by group transforms, is correctly stated; relative-scale fallback and missing-unit warnings are present. Listed translation-overlay samples are useful. No concrete expected-coordinate or equivalent acceptance comparison establishes composition order and unknown-unit behavior together; upstream Affine behavior remains an investigation. This is substantial but incomplete under the frozen full-credit check.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Associated label discovery and registration
controls.rationale: Declared labels container, source.image default, intermediate hierarchy and transform propagation are identified. Final notes relocate labels registration to image attributes, conflicting with correct leads; the spec lead weakens equal level count to SHOULD. No source-identity/coordinate validation check resolves association before overlay. Correct mechanisms receive half despite these unresolved contradictions.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Categorical label identity
controls.rationale: Integer types and label-value keyed color/property mappings are correct; the spec lead correctly preserves recommended color use. No exact integer range, uint64 precision boundary or categorical resampling rule/check. Large-label rendering remains deferred.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Metadata-driven chunk decoding
controls.rationale: Real nested sharding/index/data codec metadata, little-endian sample and possible BE support gaps are identified. Library reuse is suggested. No reverse pipeline/transpose/layout discrimination or evidence-backed admitted codec boundary. The frozen half criterion explicitly covers library/compression lists without these checks.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

controls.title: Absent data versus failed reads
controls.rationale: Silent zero masking and swallowed parse errors are recognized; fill_value is observed and its meaning left for investigation. The question-mark missing-chunks-to-zeros proposal is provisional, not a proven correction. No nonzero fill versus IO/decode/cancellation distinction or source-write check. Half credits the useful error distinction only.
controls.proposed_disposition: Retain useful mechanism; close listed gap before full/accepted-repair credit.
controls.source_authority: Primary specifications and researcher-cited code/metadata; no runtime conformance asserted.

novel_useful_candidates.mechanism: Schema validity and reader/display support are different diagnostic outcomes.
novel_useful_candidates.disposition: Useful independent candidate: preserve malformed versus unsupported distinction; revise the draft tier list before adoption (missing translation is optional, and unsupported decoding cannot become a caveat on displayed pixels).
novel_useful_candidates.authority: Versioned primary schemas/spec plus tool references; not runtime validation.

novel_useful_candidates.mechanism: Shard index and chunk geometry influence local plane-read cost and bounded memory.
novel_useful_candidates.disposition: Useful independent performance research candidate; measure representative local files before accepting latency claims. Sampled shard anatomy does not establish writer-wide defaults.
novel_useful_candidates.authority: Primary metadata and project performance documentation; issue reports are hypotheses.

novel_useful_candidates.mechanism: Multiple-image containers need explicit discovery/presentation or declared limited support.
novel_useful_candidates.disposition: Useful scope decision, not an automatically accepted requirement to support every plate/collection. Distinguish multiple multiscales entries from series/HCS containers.
novel_useful_candidates.authority: Primary specification; historical tested matrix explicitly pre-v3.

novel_useful_candidates.mechanism: OMERO channel windows/defaults can inform display initialization.
novel_useful_candidates.disposition: Useful independent rendering-policy candidate; choose fallback and validation behavior, do not turn optional metadata into mandatory feature breadth.
novel_useful_candidates.authority: Primary specification plus reported reader code observation.

precision_scope_findings.evidence: notes.md Established obligations; real-v05-fileset-anatomy catalog inference
precision_scope_findings.finding: Legacy support, all-image/HCS traversal and never-reimplement library selection are asserted as obligations. The thin 0.5 fixture does not authorize those universal obligations. Catalog counts show available examples, not representative demand.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Keep compatibility, container breadth and library choice as explicit decisions with valid unsupported outcomes.

precision_scope_findings.evidence: notes.md Coverage 1; spec-05-format-obligations labels bullet; reader leads
precision_scope_findings.finding: Final synopsis puts labels path registration in image ome attrs; correct leads locate it in the labels container. The spec lead says equal scale counts SHOULD where the current 0.5 specification requires equality.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Correct location and normative strength before derivative Plan adoption.

precision_scope_findings.finding: The lead calls repeated tiles a zarr-v3 decode/render bug in the web stack. The reporter later said the issue was likely unrelated to VIV/Vizarr. Final notes still call it a rendering bug without this qualification. An open issue and screenshot are not a root-cause finding.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Retain only a reported symptom/test candidate; do not claim proven viewer causation.

precision_scope_findings.evidence: notes.md Coverage 3; ecosystem-v05-readiness Reading; reader-ome-zarr-py-architecture PyPI bullet
precision_scope_findings.finding: Generic current zarr>=3, py>=3.10 advice is insufficient and stale for current branches: zarr-python and ome-zarr-py currently declare Python >=3.12. Historical Python requirements require exact package versions.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Pin a chosen package/version and its published requirements; no Python architecture is yet adopted.

precision_scope_findings.evidence: format-roadmap-rfcs-06 release bullet; ecosystem-v05-readiness correction appendix
precision_scope_findings.finding: Roadmap says #404 and #413 merged, but #404 was closed unmerged. Ecosystem base text attributes napari pin resolution to #123; appended correction correctly distinguishes the earlier dependency bump from later direct-zarr migration.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Rewrite obsolete statements instead of retaining conflicting base prose and appendices; the corrected napari timeline is useful, not a new failure.

precision_scope_findings.evidence: validation-diagnostics tier list; zarr-v3-read-performance plane-read bullet; real-v05-fileset-anatomy Confirms sentence
precision_scope_findings.finding: Missing-chunks-to-zeros has an explicit question mark; plane reads are oversimplified as one chunk decode per plane; two metadata examples cannot prove writer-wide sharding defaults. None is a measured runtime finding.
precision_scope_findings.disposition: Treat as hypotheses. Chunk count follows geometry; distinguish valid fill from failure before adopting diagnostics.

limitations: Sixteen lead documents are research containers, not sixteen accepted independent findings. No exhaustive atomic precision denominator was constructed.
The four novel candidates are selected independently useful mechanisms, not an exhaustive count or accepted repairs.
No measured prior-knowledge score, no injected-bug recovery claim, no causality inference from researcher volume.
No native delivery/budget audit performed here; parent owns that check. No participant feedback or live job mutations.
Current primary pages were read on review date; their mutable branch status is not a pinned runtime dependency.
